Container.Name: ollama-intel-vulkan
Container.Overview: EXPERIMENTAL: Ollama with Intel iGPU acceleration via the Vulkan backend (Mesa/ANV). Runs stock upstream Ollama, so the newest models and features work immediately and the image is much smaller than the SYCL build. If you get garbled output on your iGPU, try OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=0 or use the stable SYCL image (ollama-intel:latest). Do not run both variants against the same GPU at the same time.

Config.Name: Ollama Data
Config.Description: Ollama models and configuration (shared format with the SYCL image — switching tags reuses downloaded models)

Config.Name: OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
Config.Description: How long to keep models loaded after last request

Config.Name: OLLAMA_IGPU_ENABLE
Config.Description: Ollama drops integrated GPUs by default; 1 opts back in (required for iGPU inference)

Config.Name: OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION
Config.Description: Set to 0 if you get garbled output on your iGPU

Config.Name: GGML_VK_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Restrict to specific Vulkan device IDs (e.g. 0); empty = all devices

Config.Name: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
Config.Description: Max parallel requests (set to 1 for limited GPU memory; empty = Ollama default)
